current.gameplay_value: Make the agricultural belt readable and harvestable: deterministic tilled field parcels per 256 m landscape cell (arable_field/pasture/orchard, 0-3 per cell with village-adjacent +1) bounded by hedgerow MultiMesh at terrain+0.02 and one ACTIVE-only CropPatch Area3D per parcel (wheat/barley/potato/beet weighted, is_grown on day planted+2, regrow 2 days via GameClock). Gives 200-600 m hedged wheat blocks visible from ridge, field-specific harvest distinct from hedgerow forage, road/track/contour alignment and mid-distance cover/wayfinding while keeping 81/128 overlay + 96/64 tilled + 1 collider/9 active and unified 54 peak. Resolves 256 m landscape-cell cultivation contract and unlocks orchard/workbench/inhabited hamlet geography.
